thread:
Alex B.: Postmortem follow-up: quick sync on action owners from the 03/23 infra outage. I'll list items and we can claim/adjust. TL;DR: recurring cache-thrash pattern, two config fixes + runbook updates + one infra automation.

Priya S.: Thanks — sending a PR checklist for owners in a bit.

Alex B.: Action 1: Investigate cache eviction pattern and add metrics/alerts (cause: prefix invalidation under heavy writes). Owner: TBD. Suggested due: 1 week. Jira: INFR-5821.

Taylor M.: I can take INFR-5821. Will add a dashboard and signal for sustained eviction rate > 5%/5m. Due 2024-04-01.

Alex B.: Awesome, @Taylor M. please update ticket with acceptance criteria: dashboard, alert, and a short runbook note.

Taylor M.: Will do.

Alex B.: Action 2: Rolling limit on background vacuum jobs to avoid spikes. Owner: TBD. Suggested due: 2 weeks. Jira: INFR-5822.

Jamie L.: I'll pick INFR-5822. Plan: add concurrency cap + circuit-breaker, test on staging.

Irene K.: For the circuit-breaker, add a fallback policy in the router so we don't route to overloaded nodes. I'll pair with Jamie for design review.

Jamie L.: Thanks Irene — want me to create the design doc in DOCS-410 and @Irene K. can review?

Irene K.: Yes. I'll review by EOD tomorrow.

Alex B.: Action 3: Update postmortem runbook for the recurring pattern and include a checklist for on-call to escalate to infra platform. Owner: TBD. Jira: RUN-47.

Priya S.: I can own RUN-47. I'll add the checklist items: identify eviction spike, check vacuum jobs, trigger emergency throttling, and notify platform oncall.

Alex B.: Great. Make sure runbook links to INFR-5821 and INFR-5822.

Priya S.: Will link and add a short playbook snippet:

```
- Check realtime eviction rate dashboard
- If >5% sustained for 10m, throttle background jobs: `jobsctl throttle --group=vacuum --pct=50`
- Fallback: reroute traffic away from hot shards
- Escalate to platform oncall if not resolved in 15m
```

Taylor M.: Small ask — add expected false-positive cases (deploys causing transient evictions). I'll add one note.

Alex B.: Action 4: Add automatic rollback policy if latency > 2s for 5m after a config change. Owner: TBD. Jira: PM-778.

Irene K.: Ops automation team can implement the rollback hook for config changes. I can shepherd PM-778 but need an infra engineer to do the code.

Jamie L.: I can implement the hook; Irene, can you be the RACI approver/assignee?

Irene K.: Yes, I'll be approver. RACI: Jamie (Responsible), Irene (Accountable), Alex (Consulted), Priya (Informed).

Alex B.: Perfect. Action 5: Postmortem follow-up review meeting scheduled next Wed 10am to check status of tickets. Owners expected to have progress updates.

ops-bot: Reminder set: Postmortem follow-up — 2024-03-27 10:00 UTC.

Priya S.: Quick note: we spotted a recurring incident pattern across two previous outages (Jan and Feb). I'm creating a parent ticket to capture the cross-cutting mitigations and long-term tracking. Parent: INFR-5900.

Alex B.: Put all the child tickets (INFR-5821, INFR-5822, PM-778, RUN-47) under INFR-5900. That'll help for the quarterly review.

Taylor M.: Done — linked INFR-5821 to INFR-5900.

Jamie L.: Linked INFR-5822.

Priya S.: RUN-47 and PM-778 linked.

Alex B.: A couple of quick acceptance criteria reminders: each ticket should have (1) owner, (2) due date, (3) PR/branch, (4) verification plan. If anything can't be done in timeframe, mark as blocked and note blockers.

Irene K.: For the verification plan, let's include a short load test to reproduce eviction pattern at 2x baseline. I'll draft the load spec.

Taylor M.: I'll coordinate with SRE to run the test on staging.

Priya S.: I'll also volunteer to run the runbook walkthrough with platform oncall next week.

Alex B.: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem doc with assignments and add a RACI table snapshot. If you prefer different owners or need to reassign, move the ticket and ping here.

Taylor M.: Quick question — do we want customer-impact mitigation steps documented separately (for support)?

Priya S.: Yes, I'll create a short customer-facing FAQ and link it from the postmortem. Ticket: CX-122. Assigning to me.

Alex B.: Closing notes: prioritization is high because this is recurring. Please respect the due dates or flag blockers early. See you Wed. :thumbsup:
